diagnostics.finding: Metadata/storage unit fixtures initially used CanvasRenderer, which requires a browser Worker. They now supply an explicit non-rendering metadata fixture; actual pixel/native behavior is verified separately in real browsers.

Escape from queued RAW review bubbled into the editor-wide modal dismissal and discarded the parent batch queue. The existing localEscape boundary now confines Escape to the active RAW dialog; actual browser tests preserve earlier approved inputs.
The production setup attempted to deselect the last required output variant. It now creates its native custom variant before deselecting presets; required-variant product behavior remains unchanged.
